title: Cabbage Codex Tree
description: A surreal bioluminescent tree shaped like an open ancient book grows from dark reflective water, its trunk formed from glowing green cabbage stems and leaves. Massive cabbage leaves form a canopy above while sliced cabbages float in the foreground, mathematical equations and symbols drift throughout the scene, and ethereal green smoke rises from a cabbage on the right.
